operation.source_intent: When not Busy, close the dialog through OpenChanged(false) and then invoke the caller OnCancel callback; while Busy, do nothing.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The shared Laravel cancel control fails closed while busy, closes through the supplied open-state callback before invoking OnCancel, suppresses duplicate in-flight dispatch, and adds no request or mutation surface. Global Posts mounts it inside a real authenticated tenant-scoped confirmation dialog.

security_boundary.tenant_context: The Global Posts consumer remains bound to the authenticated active tenant and existing tenant.context route.
security_boundary.permission: content.view for the read surface; content.edit gates the destructive action.
security_boundary.authorization_test: GlobalPostsConfirmTrashTerminalityTest proves guests are unauthorized and view-only users cannot mutate.
security_boundary.tenant_isolation_test: GlobalPostsConfirmTrashTerminalityTest proves a caller cannot operate on a foreign tenant or foreign site.

coverage: exact AIMW-SYNC-2A8778C6EA production and test markers
